title: v0.1.3 — Windows installer and CLI-backed Desktop
summary: Windows Setup.exe bundles the Babel CLI and Node runtime. Desktop supports provider keys, enabled/default models and verified Docker sandbox preparation. Published bytes, installer lifecycle and native UI were checked; the Windows packages are unsigned.

title: v0.1.1 — unsigned Windows portable preview and CLI tarball published
summary: GitHub release v0.1.1 publishes an unsigned Windows x64 portable preview (ZIP plus SHA256SUMS) and attaches an npm-format CLI tarball for transparency. That release did not publish an npm registry package or attach a Setup.exe; the source installation path was clone + build.

title: Tag-triggered Windows portable bundle workflow merged (PR #312)
summary: CI builds the unsigned Windows portable bundle for v* tags and opens a draft release; publishing is a separate owner action. This milestone alone publishes nothing.

title: Installer lifecycle qualification merged (PR #313)
summary: An NSIS per-user Setup.exe builder and lifecycle harness land in CI. At that milestone no Setup.exe was attached to a release; the published preview was the portable ZIP, with no code signing.

title: Windows runtime and first-launch packaging merged (PR #306)
summary: Desktop packaging work landed on main as a source milestone: at that point no public Desktop download or installer qualification existed yet. The v0.1.1 release later published an unsigned portable preview; that release did not publish an installer.

title: v0.1.0 — first public pre-1.0 source release
summary: First public source tag of Babel. The release tag carries no downloadable assets; install remains clone + build.
